scenarios.description: Hostel management website with live room availability, bed-level booking inquiries and a student CRM that tracks enquiries, move-in dates and fee follow-ups. Synthetic simulation request.
Hotel website with room types, online reservation requests, booking management for the front desk and customer follow-up reminders after each stay. Synthetic simulation request.
Restaurant website with an editable menu, table reservation requests, opening hours and a simple customer list for repeat-guest offers. Synthetic simulation request.
Gym membership website plus CRM: membership leads, free trial bookings, plan pricing, and renewal follow-up reminders thirty days before expiry. Synthetic simulation request.
Business services company website with company lead capture, quotation requests, a sales pipeline with stages, and a CRM for account managers. Synthetic simulation request.
Consumer-facing online business website with customer inquiry forms, sales tracking per product line and a customer support inbox. Synthetic simulation request.
Custom five-page marketing website with a blog, contact form, fast loading, basic SEO and an admin area for editing page content. Synthetic simulation request.
Build a CRM with lead capture, contact timelines, configurable sales pipeline stages, task reminders and a weekly pipeline report. Synthetic simulation request.
Multi-tenant SaaS product for appointment scheduling: tenant onboarding, subscription plans, role based access and a usage dashboard. Synthetic simulation request.
E-commerce website with product catalogue, cart, order tracking and inventory counts. Payments are out of scope for this simulation. Synthetic simulation request.
Cross-platform mobile application for customers to book services, receive status updates and view invoices, with an admin web panel. Synthetic simulation request.
Automate repetitive business processes with AI: classify incoming requests, draft replies for human approval and route tasks to the right team. Synthetic simulation request.
Customer support chatbot answering common questions from a knowledge base, collecting contact details and handing over to a human agent when unsure. Synthetic simulation request.
Business dashboard and reporting: daily sales, lead conversion, outstanding follow-ups and exportable monthly reports for management. Synthetic simulation request.
Third-party integration and workflow automation: sync leads between the website, a spreadsheet and the CRM, with retry on failure and an audit log. Synthetic simulation request.
